scope: Read-only source and local evidence investigation. No backend query, database write, browser run, fixture creation, test, or build.

existing_fixture_manifest.finding: The inspected local capture reports, stabilization runs, and test-results filenames contain no designated campaign-owned research topic/source manifest for this case. The approved admin organization fixture exists with mode 0600, but proves neither queued research sources nor member access. No scoped topic IDs were available to justify a production data read.
evidence: test-results/admin-profile-approved-organization-private.json: filesystem mode only, contents not read

required_manifest.principal_and_access: One verified admin principal and a separate verified member principal, each with an explicitly selected device organization; record each topic's owning organization and prove both principals can see the intended rows independently.
required_manifest.topic: At least two campaign-owned disposable accessible topics for project grouping; record topic IDs, organization IDs, provisioning owner, and cleanup owner.
required_manifest.row_fields: For each source record source ID, topic ID, controlled URL/expected page identity, queue bucket, is_included, scrape_status, server_attempts, server_gave_up, policy_category, extension attempted_levels, role visibility, branch assignment, and restoration method. Do not include page text or credentials.
branch_assignments: Separate ordinary L1, L2, L3 cancel, L3 Go, L3 Expect thin, L4 submit, and L4 no-submit rows, all qualifying in their exact buckets.
Separate gated_login and low_value parked rows with prior extension attempts for Retry, plus an ordinary prior-attempt Retry row.

Separate disposable rows for accept_as_is, gated, dead_link, retry, content_mismatch, and ignored verdicts. The wrong-content URL must load a different page; the ignore URL must be neither dead nor gated.
Six buckets must be populated when their individual filter assertions run. Fifteen disjoint rows per role run is only a planning lower bound, not a readiness claim.

product_and_api_path.create_topic: POST /research/topics creates a topic with admitted actor and explicit X-Organization-Id; no project is required. Use only a campaign-owned organization and record the resulting ID.
product_and_api_path.add_source: POST /research/topics/{topic_id}/sources adds a URL idempotently but starts it pending, included, with zero server attempts. It does not by itself make an ordinary queue fixture.
product_and_api_path.natural_queue_path: A controlled source must pass through actual server scrape attempts until thin/failed plus server_gave_up. The queue then derives ordinary L1-L4 from chrome_extension rs_content capture_level history; domain policy may force a floor. Parked gated_login/low_value rows use separate nonterminal policy selection.
product_and_api_path.partial_reset: PATCH /research/topics/{topic_id}/sources/{source_id} permits only is_included, is_stale, and scrape_status. It cannot restore server attempt accounting, policy category, extension capture history, verdict audit, or consumed paste/capture content. A pending ordinary source is absent from the extension queue until later server processing qualifies it again.
product_and_api_path.cleanup: No topic/source DELETE route or full fixture reset route was found in the inspected research router. Terminal verdicts and successful paste leave the queue. Cleanup therefore requires a named owner and a sanctioned scoped archive/delete or replenishment procedure with exact ID and readback receipts; do not apply it to unrelated records.

next_concrete_action: Assign a fixture owner to provision two disposable topics and controlled URLs through the admitted topic/source APIs, drive or otherwise sanction the exact queue-state preparation, then produce a scoped per-role source-ID manifest and a restoration/cleanup receipt. Verify the resulting queue with the real member and admin principals before admitting the capture run. Keep naturally thin and recoverable-error branches unverified if they do not occur.
